title: Home to what?
notes: HU36157 (1300 px) is INSET with a slow DRIFT inside the inset, per the plan; HU36188 (5163 px) pushes toward the bus.

The NHS picture is Your Very Good Health (1948, colour) shot 18 (288.37–307.81): an animated map of towns and a river, each town gaining white hospital buildings. It is a map of a region rather than an outline of Britain; it reads as 'hospitals everywhere'.

P1.12 'Both of those things happened in the same country': the plan's split screen (1948 map left, 2017 card right) is cut here as two pictures in sequence (map 2 s, QT-TEASE 2 s), because the preview shows one picture at a time. In Premiere build it as a true split.

Keynes still (1348×1470) gets the plan's gentle push only (1.00→1.06), toward Keynes (the left figure, hat in hand; Kingsley Martin is right). The PUSH-under-1920 warning is intended. LOWER-KEYNES rides on V4 over it for the whole of 'John Maynard Keynes.'
Newborn: A Diary for Timothy shot 5 (107.68–117.12), the baby asleep in the cot, close. TITLE comes in at 84.0 for 6 s to the end of the movement (DIP to movement 2 on its out).
DATA-DEBT-1 wording follows facts.md (about 2½ × a year's income; the storyboard wants '249%, OBR' in the source caption, which is owed in the end credits).
